description: One place owns each piece of state and is the only code that writes it; every other reader derives from it.
A value computed from other state, expressed with `computed()` instead of stored and synchronized by hand.
Data that lives on a server and is only cached in the app. It has loading, error and freshness concerns of its own.
State such as filters, sort and page kept in the route so it survives reloads and can be shared as a link.
Transient state disappears with the page; persisted state is written to storage and needs a version to evolve safely.
